summary: Phase 4C & 4D testing completed. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified: Leave & Sickness tab with balance calculations, Operational tab with heatmap and under-coverage alerts, Staff List notes modal with CRUD.

issues: 60-second idle timeout may auto-logout during testing

GET /api/leave/overview - 28 day annual entitlement verified for all staff
GET /api/leave/overview - Balance calculation: remaining = entitlement - used
GET /api/leave/sickness-trends - Bradford formula verified: S^2 * D
PUT /api/leave/mark-rtw/{leave_id} - Endpoint exists (returns 404 for missing ID)
POST /api/manager/notes/{employee_id}?content=test - Creates note with id, content, timestamp
GET /api/operational/heatmap?year=2026&month=2 - Returns 28 days with E/L/N/LD per day
GET /api/operational/heatmap - Each shift has total, nurses, carers, baseline_met
GET /api/operational/under-coverage - Returns alerts with date, shift, time, nurses/carers needed
All endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
Manager role authorization verified for all Phase 4C/4D endpoints
